metadata.case_name: HO SIK TUNG v. LAU KIN SUN T/A E & J ENGINEERING CO. AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: worked six days at a noodle shop (earned total of $1,800)

injuries.description: compound right Pilon fracture of the distal tibia and fibula
source: compound right Pilon fracture of the distal tibia and fibula
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

injuries.description: closed fracture of the 4th and 5th metatarsal bone of the right foot
source: closed fracture of the 4th and 5th metatarsal bone of the right foot

injuries.description: a bony fragment protruding out of the skin at medial aspect of the right ankle
injuries.body_part: medial aspect of the right ankle
source: a bony fragment protruding out of the skin at medial aspect of the right ankle
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: lost some movement of his right foot
soft tissue swelling around the medial and lateral side of the right lower leg and ankle, with mild swelling in the toes of the right foot
he has to rest for between half an hour to one hour before he could start walking each morning
unable to walk for longer than one hour and would have painful ankle and pain on top of his feet while he walked up slopes
weakness on his right leg generally, unable to climb up or down stairs or a ladder
pain on the right knee while walking and pain in the back of his right lower leg
would have swollen and painful right leg after prolonged standing and cannot work or stand for long hours
unable to enjoy sports he used to enjoy, including running and hiking
20 per cent chance of development of post-traumatic arthritis later on (Dr Chiang)
10 per cent probability of late post-traumatic changes in the subtalar joint of his right leg (Dr Chiang)

treatments_received: emergency operation of close reduction and external fixation of his right foot
close reduction and external fixation on 23 July 1996
debridement, larvage of wound, adjustment of external fixator, open reduction, fibular plating and skin grafting on 25 July 1996, 31 July 1996 and 6 August 1996, respectively
open reduction, internal fixation and bone grafting on 22 August 1996
removal of K-wire and external fixator on 31 October 1996
physiotherapy, attended three times a week, total of 50 sessions at the Yung Fung Shu Clinic

losses.description: unable to walk for longer than one hour; difficulty climbing stairs or a ladder; weakness of right leg; needs to rest before walking; painful ankle and pain on top of feet when walking up slopes

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: can no longer enjoy the sports he used to enjoy, and these include running and hiking
unable to continue working as a caisson worker / driller and unable to work long hours or stand for long hours, limiting ability to pursue previous employment
